question: Which of the following types of elements is included in the leftmost group of the periodic table?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Alkali metals.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**__**Alkali metals:**__

__
 
• **Alkali metals belong to the s-block elements** occupying the **leftmost side** of the periodic table.
 
• Alkali metals** readily lose electrons**, making them ;the most reactive elements on earth.
 
• In general ‘alkali’ refers to the **basic or alkaline nature** of their metal hydroxides.
 
• The compounds are called alkali metals because when they **react with water** they** usually form alkalies which are strong bases** that can easily neutralize the strong acids.
 
• Alkali metals have an outer electronic configuration (ns1).
 
• They occupy the** first column of the periodic table.**
 
• Alkali elements are **Lithium(Li), Sodium(Na), Potassium (K), Rubidium (Ru), Cesium (Cs) and Francium (Fr)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Our periodic table is given by **Moseley **and has in total** 7 periods running horizontally and 18 groups running vertically.**
 
• They are also further divided into **s, p, d, and f blocks** depending on the placement of the outermost electrons.
 
• Elements belonging to the same blocks resemble their chemical and physical properties.
 
 
• The **s block elements** lie in the 1st and 2nd groups.
 
• The** p block elements** belong to groups 13-18.
 
• The** d and f block elements** lie in the middle from group number 3-12.
